title: 第13章 红茄果第14章 来袭
slug: 我在民俗世界打造洞天福地
content_zh:
;;
翌日清晨。
沈易照常来到院子里，拆起刚才杀死的灯笼鬼内部的阴魂木。
【已收集材料：阴魂木*24】
终于凑够将镇阴木屋升到2级的二十根阴魂木了。
沈易神色一动。
【镇阴木屋·1级（升级中120）】
【功能：可抵挡一阶妖魔侵袭】
【特性：镇阴（白色，对靠近木屋的阴属性妖物会造成小幅伤害）】
【耐久值：99.8100】
……
历经四个晚上，房子的耐久值才减少0.2。
如果一直都只是抵御灯笼鬼的话，镇阴木屋的灵纹效果可以维持五年多的时间！
目前1级镇阴木屋应该是够用了。
先存着二十根阴魂木，到日后若遇到实在解决不了的事情，再升级镇阴木屋也不迟。
“等会我打算进黑山一趟。”
饭中。
沈易对弟弟妹妹说起了外出打猎的打算。
“大哥，我跟你一起去！”沈坤丝毫没有考虑，说道。
这些天他们已经将鹿肉吃得差不多了。

再加上沈易进了气血境一重之后，饭量大了不少，一顿能吃掉四五斤鹿肉。
必须要想办法再打些猎物才行。
否则养分摄入跟不上，他们修炼蛮牛功的进度便会停滞不前。
“我一个人去就行了。”
沈易摇头否决了弟弟的提议。
沈坤跟沈鸢心头一急，“那怎么行？！”
前几天大哥满身血迹回来的场景，仍旧历历在目。
他们不希望再次看到这个场景。
“没事，我就在黑山边缘处逛逛，不会太深入。”
看着他们倔强的模样，沈易沉声说道：
“我已经迈入了气血境，力量、速度跟反应比以前提升了不少，绝不会像上次那般陷入险境了。”
他顿了顿，“你们目前最需要做的，便是尽快成为修行者，到那时候才能够真正帮上我的忙。”
沈易填饱肚子后，没有耽搁时间。
起身穿戴整齐，提起长弓便出了门。
留下沈坤和沈鸢二人，他们面色认真无比在院落练起蛮牛桩，争取早日破境。
……
出了小院后。
沈易望向前面那一座即便是在白天也显得黑暗阴沉的巨大山脉，深吸一口气。

The next morning.
Shen Yi came to the yard as usual and dismantled the ghost wood inside the lantern ghost he had just killed.
[Collected materials: Ghost Wood*24]
Finally, I got enough 20 Yin Soul Woods to upgrade the Yin-Suppressing Wooden House to Level 2.
Shen Yi's expression changed.
[Zhenyin Wooden House·Level 1 (upgrading 120)]
[Function: Can resist the invasion of first-level demons]
[Characteristics: Yin-suppressing (white, causing small damage to Yin-type monsters close to the wooden house)]
[Durability value: 99.8100]
…
It took four nights for the house's durability to decrease by 0.2.
If you just resist the lantern ghost all the time, the spiritual pattern effect of the Zhenyin Wooden House can last for more than five years!
The current Level 1 townhouse should be enough.
Save twenty pieces of Yin Hun Wood first. If you encounter something that really can't be solved in the future, it won't be too late to upgrade the Yin Suppression Wood House.
"I plan to go to Montenegro later."
During the meal.
Shen Yi told his younger brothers and sisters about his plans to go hunting.
"Brother, I'll go with you!" Shen Kun said without thinking at all.
They had eaten almost as much venison as they could these days.
In addition, after Shen Yi entered the first level of Qi and Blood Realm, his appetite increased a lot and he could eat four to five kilograms of venison in one meal.
We must find a way to hunt more prey.
Otherwise, if their nutritional intake cannot keep up, their progress in practicing Man Niu Gong will stagnate.
"I'll just go alone."
Shen Yi shook his head and rejected his brother's proposal.
Shen Kun and Shen Yuan were anxious, "How can that be done?!"
The scene where my eldest brother came back covered in blood a few days ago is still vivid in my mind.
They don't want to see this scene again.
"It's okay. I'll just wander around the edge of the Black Mountain. I won't go too deep."
Seeing their stubborn looks, Shen Yi said in a deep voice:
"I have entered the Qi and Blood Realm. My strength, speed and reaction have improved a lot compared to before. I will never be in danger like last time."
He paused, "What you need to do most right now is to become a practitioner as soon as possible. Only then will you be able to really help me."
After Shen Yi filled his stomach, he didn't waste time.
He got up and dressed neatly, picked up his long bow and went out.
Shen Kun and Shen Yuan were left behind, with extremely serious expressions on their faces, as they practiced bullfighting in the courtyard, striving to break through as soon as possible.
…
After leaving the small courtyard.
Shen Yi looked at the huge mountain range in front of him that looked dark and gloomy even in the daytime, and took a deep breath.
